name: validate_delivery_date
description: Validate and normalize delivery dates with business rules. Handles relative dates (today, tomorrow) and prevents past dates.

raw_date_input.description: The raw date input from user (e.g., '12 sept', 'tomorrow', 'next week')

extracted_date.description: The initially extracted/parsed date in YYYY-MM-DD format

current_date.description: Current date in YYYY-MM-DD format for reference

is_valid.description: Whether the date is valid for delivery

normalized_date.description: The final normalized date in YYYY-MM-DD format, null if invalid

user_friendly_message.description: User-friendly message explaining the validation result or asking for clarification

confidence.description: Confidence in the date interpretation and validation
